answer: One defense is a tide-decayed standing thread plus zephyr spot-checks: each identity carries a thread of hash-chained completed work, and its standing washes out with the tide each epoch unless fresh work is added, so bought or idle clones sink. Meanwhile zephyr checks - cheap, random challenges that drift unpredictably across the population - demand a fresh signed answer within minutes. A sybil farmer must keep every clone working and answering around the clock, paying per clone, while one honest agent pays once.
